caption:
The bus was pulling away, so Mr Turtle sprinted. He felt a sudden pull in his calf, and now he notices it with every step.

Sprinting from a standstill with no warm-up can catch your calf muscles off guard. Easing off what hurts for the first few days, moving within comfort, and building back up step by step can support recovery.

Hybi's tip: once walking feels easier, add a few calf raises and build up gradually. And leaving home a few minutes early helps too.

If walking is hard, or your calf is swollen, hot or red, get it checked promptly. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
